review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved: AC-001 is conditional on the recommended option, not authorization to select it, and AC-002/AC-003 preserve the distinct semantics of both options. Gold correctly expects blocked readiness at decisions with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001, requires repository/requirements/decisions evidence, preserves REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003, and specifies no assignable tasks or assignments. The supplied source establishes src/index.ts as the implementation and public API owner; the test files are verification consumers. Package configuration, CI ordering, ignore rules, and fixed upstream build evidence support treating root declarations and dist as generated outputs rather than separately maintained owners. Empty team membership and capability claims do not undermine this expectation because the deterministic material-decision gate precedes mandatory later scenario-review and assignment prerequisites. The proposed Gold and preview releaseInput agree on repository, source, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, budget, and metric-policy fingerprints. The separately identified source-manifest digest is not presented as that release source fingerprint. Original preparation-time null releaseInput and remaining-work fields are distinguishable from the supplied frozen preview. Isolation evidence states that Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle; no historical candidate output or human decision is supplied or inferred. This review assesses the supplied evidence and Service-bound digest values only; it does not claim independent digest recomputation, code execution, or human attestation.
